title: Clean old package versions from the pacman cache
summary: Remove old versions of installed packages from the local package cache to free up disk space, keeping only the most recent ones.

steps.explain: Run paccache to remove all cached package versions except the 3 most recent ones for each installed package.

alternatives.explain: Keep a specific number of recent versions instead of the default 3.

placeholders.name: NUM_VERSIONS
placeholders.description: The number of recent package versions to keep.

warnings: This deletes old package files from the cache. You cannot downgrade to a version that has been deleted.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo command for paccache. If you need a specific old version, you must download it manually from the Arch Linux Archive or another mirror.
